description: Cost of terminating an employee in Brazil, Mexico, the Philippines, the UAE, Spain, Türkiye or Chile: statutory severance, notice, proportional 13th month/aguinaldo, vacation and FGTS items, with the legal rule per line. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; reason depends on country (ph: redundancy, retrenchment, closure, disease, just_cause, resignation, mutual; br: dismissal, mutual, resignation, just_cause; mx: dismissal, resignation, mutual; ae: termination, resignation, mutual; es: improcedente, objetivo, temporal, resignation; tr: dismissal, resignation; cl: necesidades_empresa, mutuo_acuerdo, renuncia).
name: calculate_severance
